descriptionByLocale.en: Introduction Located on the Lausanne campus, within the Rolex Learning Center, the EPFL Library is a key partner of the university community. The Library is a centre of expertise and expertise in scientific information, serving EPFL's teaching and research missions. The Training team (5 people) develops and offers a range of training for student and research communities at EPFL. It supports the development of informational skills throughout the academic career. She is thus involved in raising awareness of the management/production of scientific information in relation to open science issues. Mission Do you like training, passing on your knowledge and being in touch with a diverse audience? Passionate and passionate about meeting the challenges, you want to help students and researchers develop their information skills and succeed in their careers? To strengthen the team, we are looking for a committed and dynamic person, ready to bring his experience to the university community. In this way, you will contribute to strengthening the information, data and AI literacy skills of the EPFL community. Main tasks and responsibilities • Development, organisation and facilitation of training • • To meet the needs of the EPFL community, in areas of expertise of the Library such as Information, Data and AI literacies • Throughout the academic career, from Bachelor level to doctoral school • Present or online, individually or in whole classes • In close collaboration with library or EPFL specialists • Creation of training in various formats and typologies (workshop, guide and tutorials, online courses, etc.) to meet the needs of a young and demanding audience. • Support for library staff on pedagogy, organisation and logistics in their training activities • Collaboration with internal and external partners EPFL to guarantee and develop a quality training offer • Participation in the reception of library users (information desk, approx. 2 hours/week) Your assets to succeed in this position: • You have significant experience in academic or equivalent library training • You have extensive knowledge of Information Literacy (technologies and tools) • You are aware of the stakes and impact on the Open Science Academy community on the production of scientific information (information search, licenses, etc.) • You have an excellent understanding of pedagogical and learning approaches • You have in-depth knowledge of AI, its issues and the impact on information skills • You have basic knowledge of scientific communication and research data management. Profile • Experience in academic library and understanding its evolving environment • Experience in training, based on a common practice of new learning modalities and technologies. • Proven knowledge of good information management practices (including reference management software and good practices) • Proactivity, openness and a high sense of service • Ability to transmit knowledge to various academic audiences • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, curiosity and desire to learn • Excellent personal organization, ability to work independently and in a team • Common French practice and good knowledge of English (min. level B2) Your level of training: • Diploma in Information Sciences (HES, University) or training deemed equivalent, with experience in academic library. Or • University title, complemented by proven experience in library
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Introduction

Située sur le campus lausannois, au sein du Rolex Learning Center, la Bibliothèque de l’EPFL est un partenaire clé de la communauté universitaire. La Bibliothèque est un centre de compétences et d’expertise en matière d’information scientifique, au service des missions d’enseignement et de recherche de l’EPFL.

L’équipe Formation (5 personnes) développe et offre un éventail de formations pour les communautés estudiantine et recherche de l’EPFL. Elle soutient le développement des compétences informationnelles tout au long du parcours académique. Elle participe ainsi à la sensibilisation à la gestion/production de l’information scientifique en lien avec les enjeux de Science ouverte.

Mission

Vous aimez former, transmettre vos connaissances et être en contact avec un public varié ? Passionné(e)et aimant relever les défis, vous souhaitez aider les étudiant.es et chercheur·euses à développer leurs compétences informationnelles et à réussir dans leurs parcours ?

Pour renforcer l’équipe, nous cherchons une personne engagée et dynamique, prête à apporter son expérience à la communauté universitaire. Vous contribuerez ainsi à renforcer les compétences en Information, Data et AI literacies de la communauté EPFL.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Développement, organisation et animation de formations

•

• Pour répondre aux besoins de la communauté EPFL, dans les domaines d’expertise de la Bibliothèque tels qu’Information, Data et AI literacies

• Tout au long du parcours académique, du niveau Bachelor à l’école doctorale

• En présentiel ou en ligne, individuellement ou à des classes entières

• En étroites collaborations avec les spécialistes de la Bibliothèque ou de l’EPFL

• Création de formation de formats et typologies variés (workshop, guide et tutoriels, cours en ligne, etc.) pour répondre aux besoins d’un public jeune et exigeant.

• Soutien aux collaborateur·trices de la Bibliothèque en matière de pédagogie, d’organisation et logistique dans leurs actions de formation

• Collaboration avec les partenaires internes et externes EPFL pour garantir et développer une offre de formation de qualité

• Participation à l’accueil des usagers de la Bibliothèque (guichet d’information, env. 2h/semaine)

Vos atouts pour réussir dans ce poste :

• Vous avez une expérience significative en formation en bibliothèque académique ou équivalente

• Vous disposez de connaissances approfondies en matière d’Information Literacy (technologies et outils)

• Vous êtes au fait des enjeux et impact sur le milieu académie de l’Open Science sur la production d’informations scientifique (recherche d’information, licences, etc.)

• Vous avez une excellente compréhension des approches pédagogiques et d’apprentissage

• Vous disposez de connaissances approfondies de l’IA, de ses enjeux et de l’impact sur les compétences informationnelles

• Vous avez des connaissances de base de la communication scientifique et de la gestion des données de recherche.

Profil

• Expérience en bibliothèque académique et compréhension de son environnement évolutif

• Expérience en formation, appuyée sur une pratique courante des nouvelles modalités et technologies d’apprentissage.

• Connaissance avérée en matière de bonnes pratiques de gestion de l’information (y compris logiciel de gestion de références et bonnes pratiques)

• Proactivité, ouverture d’esprit et sens aigu du service

• Capacité à transmettre des connaissances auprès de publics académiques variés

• Fortes capacités analytiques et conceptuelles, curiosité et désir d'apprendre

• Excellente organisation personnelle, aptitude à travailler de façon autonome et en équipe

• Pratique courante du français et bonne connaissance de l’anglais (min. niveau B2)

Votre niveau de formation :

• Diplôme en Sciences de l’information (HES, Université) ou formation jugée équivalente, avec expérience en bibliothèque académique.

Ou

• Titre universitaire, complété par une expérience avérée en biblioth

Profilo • Esperienza nella biblioteca accademica e comprensione del suo ambiente in evoluzione • Esperienza nella formazione, basata su una pratica comune di nuove modalità e tecnologie di apprendimento. • Conoscenza comprovata delle buone pratiche di gestione dell'informazione (compreso il software di gestione di riferimento e le buone pratiche) • Proattività, apertura e un alto senso di servizio • Capacità di trasmettere conoscenze a vari pubblico accademico • Forte capacità analitiche e concettuali, curiosità e desiderio di imparare • Eccellente organizzazione personale, capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in un team • Pratica francese comune e buona conoscenza dell'inglese (livello B2) Il vostro livello di formazione: • Diploma in Scienze dell'Informazione (HES, Università) o formazione considerata equivalente, con esperienza in biblioteca accademica. O • Titolo dell'Università, completato da comprovata esperienza in biblioteca
descriptionByLocale.de: Die EPFL Library befindet sich auf dem Campus Lausanne im Rolex Learning Center und ist ein wichtiger Partner der Universitätsgemeinschaft. Die Bibliothek ist ein Kompetenzzentrum und Know-how in wissenschaftlichen Informationen, die EPFL Lehre und Forschungsmissionen dienen. Das Trainingsteam (5 Personen) entwickelt und bietet eine Reihe von Schulungen für Studenten und Forschungsgemeinschaften an der EPFL an. Es unterstützt die Entwicklung von Informationskompetenzen während der gesamten akademischen Laufbahn. Sie beteiligt sich daher an der Sensibilisierung für das Management / die Produktion wissenschaftlicher Informationen in Bezug auf Open-Science-Themen. Mission Magst du Training, gibst dein Wissen weiter und bist in Kontakt mit einem vielfältigen Publikum? Leidenschaftlich und leidenschaftlich für die Bewältigung der Herausforderungen, möchten Sie Studenten und Forschern helfen, ihre Informationsfähigkeiten zu entwickeln und in ihrer Karriere erfolgreich zu sein? Um das Team zu stärken, suchen wir eine engagierte und dynamische Person, die bereit ist, ihre Erfahrung in die Universitätsgemeinschaft einzubringen. Auf diese Weise tragen Sie dazu bei, die Informations-, Daten- und KI-Kenntnisse der EPFL-Gemeinschaft zu stärken. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten • Entwicklung, Organisation und Erleichterung der Ausbildung • • Um den Bedürfnissen der EPFL-Gemeinschaft in den Fachgebieten der Bibliothek wie Informationen, Daten und KI-Kenntnisse gerecht zu werden • Während der gesamten akademischen Laufbahn, vom Bachelor bis zur Doktorandenschule • Gegenwart oder Online, einzeln oder in ganzen Klassen • In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Bibliotheks- oder EPFL-Spezialisten • Erstellung von Schulungen in verschiedenen Formaten und Typologien (Workshop, Guide und Tutorials, Online-Kurse usw.), um den Bedürfnissen eines jungen und anspruchsvollen Publikums gerecht zu werden. • Unterstützung der Bibliotheksmitarbeiter in den Bereichen Pädagogik, Organisation und Logistik bei ihren Schulungsaktivitäten • Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern EPFL zur Gewährleistung und Entwicklung eines qualitativ hochwertigen Schulungsangebots • Teilnahme am Empfang der Bibliotheksnutzer (Informationsschalter, ca. 2 Stunden/Woche) Ihr Vermögen, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein: • Sie verfügen über umfangreiche Erfahrung in der akademischen oder gleichwertigen Bibliotheksausbildung • Sie verfügen über umfassende Kenntnisse der Informationskompetenz (Technologien und Werkzeuge) • Sie kennen den Einsatz und die Auswirkungen auf die Open Science Academy-Community auf die Produktion wissenschaftlicher Informationen (Informationssuche, Lizenzen usw.) • Sie haben ein ausgezeichnetes Verständnis für pädagogische und Lernansätze • Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse der KI, ihrer Probleme und der Auswirkungen auf die Informationskompetenz • Sie verfügen über Grundkenntnisse der wissenschaftlichen Kommunikation und des Forschungsdatenmanagements. Profil • Erfahrung in der akademischen Bibliothek und das Verständnis ihrer sich entwickelnden Umgebung • Erfahrung in der Ausbildung, basierend auf einer gemeinsamen Praxis neuer Lernmodalitäten und Technologien. • Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse über gute Informationsmanagement-Praktiken (einschließlich Referenzmanagement-Software und bewährte Praktiken) • Proaktivität, Offenheit und ein hohes Maß an Service • Fähigkeit, Wissen an verschiedene akademische Zielgruppen weiterzugeben • Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, Neugierde und Lernwunsch • Ausgezeichnete persönliche Organisation, Fähigkeit, unabhängig und im Team zu arbeiten • Gemeinsame französische Praxis und gute Englischkenntnisse (Mindeststufe B2) Ihr Ausbildungsniveau: • Diplom in Informationswissenschaften (HES, Universität) oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung mit Erfahrung in der akademischen Bibliothek. Oder • Universitätstitel, ergänzt durch nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Bibliothek

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

The Microbial Physiology and Resource Biorecovery Laboratory (MICROBE), led by Dr. Wenyu Gu at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL), invites applications for a fully funded Postdoctoral Researcher position in Microbial Ecology.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented postdoctoral researcher to join our team at the Institute of Environmental Engineering. The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research in applied and environmental microbiology, with a particular focus on microbial community assembly and interaction principles using anaerobic digestion communities as a model system.

Main duties and responsibilities

Anaerobic digestion communities are among the best-characterized and most ecologically important microbial ecosystems. Composed of diverse bacteria and archaea that cooperate through metabolic interactions, these communities drive the degradation of organic matter in oxygen-free environments and ultimately produce methane. They play a central role in global carbon cycling and provide an excellent model for investigating fundamental questions in microbial ecology, including community assembly, species interactions, resilience, and ecosystem functioning.

Using enrichment cultures combined with metabolite profiling and multi-omics analyses, our group has recently revealed that: (1) environmental selection imposed by pH and substrate availability constrains metabolic network architecture despite substantial taxonomic turnover in anaerobic digestion communities, providing a mechanistic explanation for convergent ecosystem functions across similar environments; and (2) amino acid fermentation requires the balancing of oxidative and reductive half-reactions, with Stickland metabolism partitioned among community members rather than encoded and expressed within individual genomes. These findings demonstrate that redox balancing during amino acid fermentation is an emergent property of the microbial community, maintained through metabolite cross-feeding. (Both studies are currently under review.)

Building on these findings, the successful candidate will investigate how microbial interactions shape ecosystem functions and how interaction principles scale in complex communities. The project combines experimental and computational approaches, including high-throughput sequencing, bioinformatics, microbial isolation and cultivation, physiological characterization, and community-level activity and function analyses.

This position is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) and EPFL. The postdoctoral researcher will collaborate closely with PhD students and fellow postdoctoral researchers within the laboratory and across EPFL’s international research network.

Profile

• PhD degree in environmental engineering, microbiology, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

• Strong publication record and demonstrated research accomplishments, including peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.

• Experience in bioinformatics and modeling is valuable.

• Strong communication and scientific writing skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international research environment.

We offer

• Mentoring and support for professional and career development.

• A stimulating, multicultural research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities.

• Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and international networking.

• A world-class research and training environment within the ETH Domain.

Informations

• Start date: Flexible.

• Contract duration: One-year contract, renewable annually for up to three years.

To apply, please follow the instructions provided in the application portal linked below.

Please prepare the following application materials:

• Motivation letter.

• Detailed curriculum vitae (CV).

• Contact information.

• Names and contact details of three references who are willing to provide rec

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

The Microbial Physiology and Resource Biorecovery Laboratory (MICROBE), led by Dr. Wenyu Gu at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL), invites applications for a fully funded PhD position in Microbial Physiology.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented PhD student to join our team at the Institute of Environmental Engineering. The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research in applied and environmental microbiology, with a focus on the physiology and genetic regulation of methane-producing archaea: methanogens. These microorganisms play a central role in the global carbon cycle by mediating the terminal steps of organic matter degradation in anoxic environments. Their activity serves as a critical gatekeeper of energy flow in oxygen-depleted ecosystems, including wetlands, sediments, animal digestive tracts, and anaerobic digesters, where they catalyze the final stages of anaerobic carbon mineralization.

Main duties and responsibilities

The research will investigate how methanogens respond to dynamic environmental conditions and interact with other members of microbial communities, advancing our understanding of the ecological mechanisms governing methane production and informing future biotechnological applications. The project will combine a range of experimental and computational approaches, including high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics, microbial isolation and cultivation, physiological characterization of gas-utilizing microorganisms, and co-culture and community function analyses.

The PhD candidate will collaborate closely with other PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, both within the laboratory and across EPFL’s international research network.

Profile

• Master's degree in environmental engineering, microbiology, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated research experience through a master's thesis, publications, or equivalent research projects.

• Prior experience in wet-lab microbiology and/or bioinformatics is an advantage.

• Strong communication and scientific writing skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international research environment.

We offer

• Mentoring and support for professional and personal development.

• A stimulating, multicultural research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities.

• Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and international networking.

• A world-class training environment within the ETH Domain.

Informations

• Contract duration: One-year contract, renewable annually for up to four years.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission

The Microbial Physiology and Resource Biorecovery Laboratory (MICROBE), led by Dr. Wenyu Gu at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL), invites applications for a fully funded PhD position in Microbial Physiology.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented PhD student to join our team at the Institute of Environmental Engineering. The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research in applied and environmental microbiology, with a focus on the physiology and genetic regulation of methane-producing archaea: methanogens. These microorganisms play a central role in the global carbon cycle by mediating the terminal steps of organic matter degradation in anoxic environments. Their activity serves as a critical gatekeeper of energy flow in oxygen-depleted ecosystems, including wetlands, sediments, animal digestive tracts, and anaerobic digesters, where they catalyze the final stages of anaerobic carbon mineralization.

Main duties and responsibilities

The research will investigate how methanogens respond to dynamic environmental conditions and interact with other members of microbial communities, advancing our understanding of the ecological mechanisms governing methane production and informing future biotechnological applications. The project will combine a range of experimental and computational approaches, including high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics, microbial isolation and cultivation, physiological characterization of gas-utilizing microorganisms, and co-culture and community function analyses.

The PhD candidate will collaborate closely with other PhD students and postdoctoral researchers, both within the laboratory and across EPFL’s international research network.

Profile

• Master's degree in environmental engineering, microbiology, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated research experience through a master's thesis, publications, or equivalent research projects.

• Prior experience in wet-lab microbiology and/or bioinformatics is an advantage.

• Strong communication and scientific writing skills in English.

• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international research environment.

We offer

• Mentoring and support for professional and personal development.

• A stimulating, multicultural research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities.

• Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and international networking.

• A world-class training environment within the ETH Domain.

Informations

• Start date: Flexible.

• Contract duration: One-year contract, renewable annually for up to four years.

• Motivation letter.

• Contact information.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Principales tâches et responsabilités

Au sein de la Durabilité EPFL, rattachée à la Vice-présidence pour le recherche et les initiatives stratégiques, votre mission sera de travailler avec des laboratoires, centres et plateformes pour estimer et diminuer leur empreinte environnementale sans impacter la qualité de la recherche.

Vous travaillerez en interface avec différentes Vice-présidences et les Facultés de l’EPFL, vous serez amené.e à:

Stratégie Green Labs

• En délégation de la cheffe de service, soutenir, suivre et garantir la planification et la mise en œuvre du volet Green Labs de la Stratégie Climat et Durabilité

• Accompagner les laboratoires, centres et plateformes dans la réduction de leur impact environnemental

• Participer à la définition d’objectifs de réduction ciblés par typologie de laboratoires

• Définir et proposer un plan de financement pour soutenir les laboratoires et plateformes dans le déploiement des mesures de réduction

• Participer aux groupes de travail nationaux et internationaux

Mission

Accompagnement des laboratoires

• Réaliser des bilans carbone des activités de recherche pour des laboratoires, centres et plateformes

• Analyser les consommations énergétiques et de ressources

• Sensibiliser les équipes de recherche

• Déployer des certifications type LEAF, Sparhub ou My Green Lab

• Conseiller sur les bonnes pratiques en matière notamment d’énergie, achats, voyages, déchets dont le plastique…

• Développer des feuilles de route et plans d’action

Communication & engagement

• Soutenir la communication en lien avec le déploiement de l’outil de quantification des activité de recherche de l’EPFL, le Calculateur CO2

• Participer et/ou organiser en délégation de la cheffe de service les séances de coordination de l’équipe Green Labs

• Organiser workshops et événements

• Créer des supports pédagogiques

• Maintenir et développer le site web

• Valoriser les initiatives des laboratoires

• Développer une culture de recherche durable

Profil

Expérience exigée

• Formation universitaire de niveau master ou doctorat, ou HES en ingénierie, sciences de l’environnement, analyse de données, sciences numériques ou équivalent

• Expérience dans des méthodes de suivi et de comptabilisation des émissions de gaz à effet de serre d’au moins 5 ans

• Expérience en gestion de projets transversaux d’au moins 5 ans

Compétences requises

• Maîtrise des principes de comptabilisation des émissions de carbone (e.g. GHG Protocol)

• Connaissance des méthodes, outils et normes pour la quantification des empreintes environnementales comme l’analyse de cycle de vie

• Intérêt marqué pour la durabilité et la réduction de l’empreinte environnementale

• Expérience avec les logiciels ACV comme SimaPro un plus

• Connaissance avérée du monde académique

• Compétence linguistique : français, anglais impératif

• Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse, aisance rédactionnelle

• Aptitude à travailler en transversalité

• Faire preuve d'autonomie, pro-activité et être force de proposition

• Ethique et rigueur scientifique

Nous offrons

•
L’opportunité de contribuer à des projets stimulants de réduction d’impacts environnementaux au sein de la recherche académique

•
Un cadre de travail flexible au sein d’une équipe dynamique et multidisciplinaire

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : Dès que possible

Taux d'occupation min : 80%

Taux d'occupation max : 100%

Type de contrat : CDD

Durée : 1 an

descriptionByLocale.en:
Main duties and responsibilities

Context – General aim of the position:

Within EPFL Sustainability, part of the Vice-Presidency for Research and Strategic Initiatives, your role will be to work with laboratories, centers and platforms to assess and reduce their environmental footprint without compromising the quality of researches.

You will liaise with various EPFL Vice-Presidencies and Faculties, and will be required to:

Green Labs Strategy

• On behalf of the head department, support, monitor and ensure the planning and implementation of the Green Labs part for the Climate and Sustainability Strategy

• Support laboratories, centers and platforms in reducing their environmental impact

• Participate in defining targets by laboratory type

• Define and propose a funding plan to support laboratories and platforms in rolling out reduction measures

• Participate in national and international working groups

Mission

Support for laboratoires

• Carrying out carbon assessments of research activities for laboratories, centers and platforms

• Analysing energy and resource consumption

• Raise awareness among research teams

• Implementing certifications such as LEAF, Sparhub or My Green Lab

• Advising on best practices, particularly regarding energy, procurement, travel, waste (including plastic), etc.

• Develop roadmaps and actions planes

Communication & engagement

• Support communication relating to the roll-out of EPFL’s research activity quantification tool, the CO2Calculator

• Participate in and/or organize, on behalf of the head department, Green Labs team coordination meetings

• Organise workshops and events

• Create educational materials

• Maintain and develop the website

• Promote the laboratories’ initiatives

• Develop a culture of sustainable research

Profile

Required experience

• Master’s or PhD level university education, or a degree from a University of Applied Sciences (HES) in engineering, environmental sciences, data analysis, digital sciences or equivalent

• 5 years’ minimum experience in methods for monitoring and accounting for GHG emissions

• 5 years’ minimum experience in managing cross-functional projects

Required skills

• Proficiency in the principles of carbon emissions accounting (e.g. GHG Protocol)

• Knowledge of methods, tools and standards for quantifying environmental footprints, such as life cycle assessment

• Strong interest in sustainability and reducing the environmental footprint

• Experience with ACV software such as SimaPro is an advantage

• Proven knowledge of the academic world

• Language skills: French and English essential

• Analytical and summarising skills, strong writing ability

• Ability to work across departments

• Demonstrate independence, proactivity and the ability to generate ideas

• Ethics and scientific integrity

We offer

• The opportunity to contribute to impactful projects aimed at reducing environmental impacts in academic research

• A flexible working environment within a dynamic, multidisciplinary team

Informations

Contract Start Date : As soon as possible

Activity Rate Min : 80%

Activity Rate Max : 100%

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year

descriptionByLocale.it:
Contesto Il Vicepresidente delle Operazioni gestisce ogni giorno tutte le attività che fanno vivere i campus EPFL, tra cui restauro, sistemi informativi, sicurezza e funzionamento, e prevede lo sviluppo della sua infrastruttura. La sua gestione è alla ricerca del futuro direttore del settore dei sistemi informativi di EPFL. Missione Il Direttore dei Sistemi Informativi fornisce una leadership strategica dell'ecosistema digitale di EPFL e dell'infrastruttura IT centrale, in stretta collaborazione con la comunità accademica. Egli federazione risorse fondamentali per garantire la resilienza digitale dell'Istituto e l'eccellenza operativa. A capo della tenuta, supervisiona un team di 160 FTE e un budget annuale di 50 MCHF. descriptionByLocale.en:
Background The Vice-President for Operations manages all activities that make EPFL campuses live on a daily basis, including restoration, information systems, security and operation, and plans the development of its infrastructure. Its management is looking for its future director of EPFL's information systems field. Mission The Director of Information Systems provides strategic leadership of EPFL's digital ecosystem and central IT infrastructure, in close collaboration with the academic community. He/she federates core resources to ensure the Institute's digital resilience and operational excellence. At the head of the estate, he/she oversees a team of 160 FTEs and an annual budget of MCHF 50. Main tasks and responsibilities Vision and federative governance
• Co-defining a visionary, ambitious and coherent digital strategy for EPFL and central IT services
• Federate teams, internal and external partners, including CEPF partners, to deploy this strategy
• Act as conductor at the Faculty level to harmonize decentralized SIs while respecting their specific agility Central IT infrastructure management
• Piloting the operation, maintenance and evolution of critical infrastructures (Datacenters, networks, storage, hybrid cloud) to ensure high availability and industrial performance
• Deploy sovereign computing capabilities (HPC) and AI environments, providing users with state-of-the-art tools under strict institutional control Digital resilience
• Ensuring the integrity of the scientific and administrative heritage through an exemplary cybersecurity policy
• Ensure that SIs are maintained that meet legal requirements and standards Academic partnership
• Act as a technology partner for laboratories by providing data management services and agile infrastructure, while respecting the single strategy framework
• Modernise teaching and learning experience by maintaining up-to-date academic ERPs of rapidly changing needs and supporting innovative digital pedagogies Responsible Transformation
• Piloting the digital sustainability path (Green IT) of the domain
• Ensuring exemplary management of human and financial resources in a spirit of innovation, performance and equity Profile Profile of "Architect-Bâtisseur" with a strong leadership influence:
• Master or PhD in computer science, engineering or equivalent; MBA or further training in business management/governance major asset
• Min. 15 years of professional experience, including at least 10 years in a large SI leadership role (CIO/CTO) in complex organisations
• Experience demonstrated in leading major digital programs, with strong change direction
• Political capacity to bring decentralized interests together while ensuring overall institutional coherence
• Synthesis and excellent communication skills
• Culture of service oriented towards academic excellence
• Proven mastery of cybersecurity, data governance and business continuity issues in exposed environments
• Languages: French-English bilingual; German an asset We offer
• A quality multicultural and academic working environment
• Opportunities for continuing training
• An involvement at the heart of EPFL's Information System Information Effective date: September 1, 2026 or to be agreed Occupancy rate: 100% Type of contract: CDI Reference: 2249 Deadline for application: 14 June 2026 Note: An extract of the criminal record will be requested when the offer is made

descriptionByLocale.it: Mission EPFL, l'Istituto federale di tecnologia svizzero di Losanna, è uno dei campus universitari più dinamici d'Europa e si colloca tra le prime 20 università di tutto il mondo. EPFL impiega oltre 6.500 persone che sostengono le tre principali missioni dell'istituzione: istruzione, ricerca e innovazione. Questa posizione si trova al Campus Biotech di Ginevra, campus associato di EPFL. Sulle rive del lago di Ginevra, Campus Biotech riunisce EPFL, l'Università di Ginevra, il Wyss Center, gli ospedali dell'Università di Ginevra (HUG), e le startup in un ecosistema unico e interdisciplinare. Il Gruppo A. Mathis per la Neuroscienze Computazionale e l'AI, sotto la supervisione del Professor Alexander Mathis, sta cercando un Assistente Amministrativo per garantire le operazioni quotidiane fluide ed efficienti del laboratorio. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con il professore, i ricercatori, gli studenti e i servizi centrali EPFL per sostenere l'esecuzione di progetti e attività quotidiane, giocando una parte centrale per consentire la ricerca e le missioni operative del laboratorio. Ti riferirai direttamente alla testa di laboratorio. • Assistenza con fondi e gestione delle borse di studio, comprese le spese di monitoraggio, rendicontazione finanziaria (salari, fatture, spese della carta di credito), previsioni finanziarie, acquisti e relazioni; • Amministrazione del personale: supporto al processo di assunzione, preparazione dei contratti di lavoro (accademico e non accademico), accreditamento, onboarding e offboarding, gestione delle assenze e degli ordini del giorno, e follow-up del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti (compresi gli intern, ricercatori). • Gestione del calendario e dell'ordine del giorno: gestione del calendario del professore, pianificazione e coordinamento delle riunioni e degli appuntamenti e supporto amministrativo generale alle attività del professore. • Organizzazione di eventi: coordinamento di viaggi, riunioni, conferenze, seminari e simposio; organizzazione di difese di tesi, riunioni di gruppo e attività di team building. • Gestione dei visitatori e della mobilità: organizzazione degli arrivi per nuovi dipendenti e ricercatori in visita, assistenza con domande di visto, alloggio e assicurazione sanitaria, e gestione completa dei viaggi per gli ospiti. • Coordinamento: lione con i servizi centrali e accademici dell'EPFL (Scuola Doctoral, Sezioni, Team Dean, ecc.), agenzie di finanziamento e partner esterni. Il tuo profilo • Prova esperienza come assistente amministrativo, idealmente in un ambiente accademico o di ricerca. • Forte capacità organizzative e capacità di gestire più priorità. • Proattiva, affidabile e orientata al servizio, con una mentalità "can-do". • È richiesta una fluidità in francese e inglese. • Proficienza del computer, con un ottimo comando di Outlook e un ottimo comando di Word, Excel e PowerPoint. La familiarità con gli strumenti di gestione del progetto è un vantaggio. • Capacità di interagire con tutti i livelli di facoltà, personale e studenti e prosperare in un ambiente multiculturale. Offriamo • eccellenti condizioni di lavoro. • Un ambiente multiculturale e stimolante. • Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo professionale. descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. This position is based at Campus Biotech in Geneva, EPFL's associated campus. On the shores of Lake Geneva, Campus Biotech brings together EPFL, the University of Geneva, the Wyss Center, the Geneva University Hospitals (HUG), and startups in a uniquely interdisciplinary ecosystem.

The A. Mathis Group for Computational Neuroscience and AI, under the supervision of Professor Alexander Mathis, is seeking an Administrative Assistant to ensure the smooth and efficient day-to-day operations of the laboratory. You will collaborate closely with the professor, researchers, students, and EPFL central services to support the execution of projects and daily activities, playing a central part in enabling the lab's research and operational missions. You will report directly to the lab head.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Assistance with funds and grants management, including monitoring expenditures, financial reporting (salaries, invoices, credit card expenses), financial forecasts, purchases, and reports;

• Staff administration: support to the hiring process, preparation of employment contracts (academic and non-academic), accreditation, onboarding and offboarding, management of absences and agendas, and follow-up of the employee lifecycle (including interns, summer interns, and visiting researchers).

• Calendar and agenda management: management of the professor's calendar, scheduling and coordinating meetings and appointments, and general administrative support to the professor's activities.

• Event organization: coordination of trips, meetings, conferences, seminars, and symposiums; organization of thesis defenses, group meetings, and team-building activities.

• Visitor and mobility management: organization of arrivals for new employees and visiting researchers, assistance with visa applications, accommodation, and health insurance, and full travel management for guests.

• Coordination: liaising with EPFL central and academic services (Doctoral School, Sections, Dean's team, etc.), funding agencies, and external partners.

Your profile

• Proven experience as an administrative assistant, ideally in an academic or research environment.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Proactive, reliable, and service-oriented, with a "can-do" mindset.

• Fluency in French and English is required.

• Computer proficiency, with an excellent command of Outlook and a very good command of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Familiarity with project management tools is a plus.

• Ability to interact with all levels of faculty, staff, and students and to thrive in a multicultural environment.

We offer

• Excellent working conditions.

• A multicultural and stimulating environment.

• Opportunities for further education and professional development.

Informations

Contract Start Date : as soon as possible

Activity Rate Min : 30.00

Activity Rate Max : 50.00

Contract Type: CDI

Duration:

Reference: 2264

Applications should be submitted exclusively through the EPFL website. Please include a CV, a cover letter, and any relevant references or diplomas.

EPFL is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.
descriptionByLocale.de: Mission Die EPFL, die Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule in Lausanne, ist einer der dynamischsten Universitätscampusse Europas und zählt zu den 20 besten Universitäten weltweit. Die EPFL beschäftigt mehr als 6.500 Mitarbeiter, die die drei Hauptaufgaben der Institution unterstützen: Bildung, Forschung und Innovation. Diese Stelle ist am Campus Biotech in Genf angesiedelt, dem angeschlossenen Campus der EPFL. Am Ufer des Genfersees bringt Campus Biotech die EPFL, die Universität Genf, das Wyss Center, die Universitätskliniken Genf (HUG) und Startups in einem einzigartigen interdisziplinären Ökosystem zusammen. Die A. Mathis-Gruppe für Computational Neuroscience und AI unter der Leitung von Professor Alexander Mathis sucht einen Verwaltungsassistenten, der den reibungslosen und effizienten täglichen Betrieb des Labors gewährleistet. Sie arbeiten eng mit den Professoren, Forschern, Studenten und den zentralen Diensten der EPFL zusammen, um die Durchführung von Projekten und täglichen Aktivitäten zu unterstützen und spielen eine zentrale Rolle bei der Ermöglichung der Forschungs- und Betriebsmissionen des Labors. descriptionByLocale.fr: Mission L'EPFL, l'École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne, est l'un des campus universitaires les plus dynamiques d'Europe et se classe parmi les 20 meilleures universités du monde. L'EPFL emploie plus de 6'500 personnes soutenant les trois missions principales de l'institution : l'éducation, la recherche et l'innovation. Ce poste est basé au Campus Biotech à Genève, campus associé à l'EPFL. Au bord du lac Léman, Campus Biotech rassemble l'EPFL, l'Université de Genève, le Wyss Center, les Hôpitaux universitaires de Genève (HUG) et des startups dans un écosystème interdisciplinaire unique. Le Groupe A. Mathis pour les neurosciences computationnelles et l'IA, sous la supervision du professeur Alexander Mathis, est à la recherche d'un adjoint administratif pour assurer le bon déroulement et l'efficacité des opérations quotidiennes du laboratoire. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec le professeur, les chercheurs, les étudiants et les services centraux de l'EPFL pour soutenir l'exécution des projets et des activités quotidiennes, jouant un rôle central dans la réalisation des missions de recherche et opérationnelles du laboratoire. Vous rapporterez directement au responsable du laboratoire. Principales tâches et responsabilités • Assistance à la gestion des fonds et des subventions, y compris le suivi des dépenses, les rapports financiers (salaires, factures, dépenses par carte de crédit), les prévisions financières, les achats et les rapports ; • Administration du personnel : soutien au processus d'embauche, préparation des contrats de travail (académiques et non académiques), accréditation, onboarding et offboarding, gestion des absences et des agendas, et suivi du cycle de vie des employés (y compris les stagiaires, les stagiaires d'été et les chercheurs invités). • Gestion du calendrier et de l'agenda : gestion du calendrier du professeur, planification et coordination des réunions et rendez-vous, et soutien administratif général aux activités du professeur. • Organisation d'événements : coordination de voyages, réunions, conférences, séminaires et colloques ; organisation de soutenances de thèse, de réunions de groupe et d'activités de team building. • Gestion des visiteurs et de la mobilité : organisation des arrivées des nouveaux collaborateurs et des chercheurs invités, assistance aux demandes de visa, d'hébergement et d'assurance maladie, et gestion complète des voyages des invités. • Coordination : liaison avec les services centraux et académiques de l'EPFL (École doctorale, sections, équipe du doyen, etc.), les agences de financement et les partenaires externes. Votre profil • Expérience avérée en tant qu'assistant administratif, idéalement dans un environnement académique ou de recherche. • Solides compétences organisationnelles et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités. • Proactif, fiable et axé sur le service, avec un état d'esprit positif. • La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est requise. • Maîtrise de l'informatique, avec une excellente maîtrise d'Outlook et une très bonne maîtrise de Word, Excel et PowerPoint. La connaissance des outils de gestion de projet est un plus. • Capacité à interagir avec tous les niveaux du corps professoral, du personnel et des étudiants et à s'épanouir dans un environnement multiculturel. Nous offrons • D'excellentes conditions de travail. • Un environnement multiculturel et stimulant. • Possibilités de formation continue et de développement professionnel. Informations Date de début du contrat : dès que possible Taux d'activité Min : 30.00 Taux d'activité Max : 50.00 Type de contrat : CDI Durée : Référence : 2264 Les candidatures doivent être soumises exclusivement via le site de l'EPFL. Veuillez inclure un CV, une lettre de motivation et toutes références ou diplômes pertinents. descriptionByLocale.it:
Riguardo a noi e al nostro progetto

La Cattedra di Modelli Numerici e Simulazione di EPFL è dedicata alla progettazione e analisi di algoritmi numerici per equazioni differenziali parziali. La nostra ricerca è orientata allo sviluppo di tecniche numeriche innovative e innovative che mirano a migliorare l'integrazione tra simulazioni numeriche e modellazione geometrica e lavorazione.

All'interno del progetto «FLASh: strumenti di simulazione rapidi per le strutture di LAttice» , finanziato dalla Fondazione Nazionale di Scienza Svizzera, stiamo aprendo una posizione post-dottorale per lo sviluppo di algoritmi efficienti per l'ottimizzazione della topologia dei materiali progettati utilizzando la tecnica degli elementi finiti

Cosa farai

Come postdoc nel nostro gruppo, guiderai la ricerca sulla progettazione e l'implementazione di metodi matematici sonori per l'ottimizzazione della topologia dei materiali progettati, sfruttando tecniche di simulazione veloci come i metodi di elementi finiti non idonei, la decomposizione di dominio, la modellazione di ordine ridotta, o l'analisi isogeometrica. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo, contribuendo allo sviluppo teorico e all'implementazione software di questi metodi. Più specificamente:

• Guidare e contribuire a progetti di ricerca nelle vaste aree di simulazione numerica e ottimizzazione della topologia, all'interno di FLASh e iniziative correlate

• Sviluppare, implementare e mantenere la simulazione interna e il software di ottimizzazione della topologia

• Analizzare, interpretare e pubblicare i risultati nelle principali riviste internazionali

• Presentare il vostro lavoro a conferenze nazionali e internazionali e costruire una forte rete nel settore

• Mentor e studenti di dottorato e master co-supervise

• Contribuire alle attività didattiche all'interno del gruppo

• Assistere nella preparazione delle proposte di sovvenzione e dei rapporti di progetto

•

Sei il candidato ideale se

• Si tiene un dottorato (o si sta avvicinando al completamento di uno) in matematica, meccanica computazionale, ingegneria, o un campo correlato

• Hai un forte background nell'ottimizzazione della topologia, idealmente con l'esperienza nei metodi basati sulla densità (SIMP), approcci di impostazione del livello, o relativi framework di design-for-manufacturing

• Hai esperienza di ricerca nei metodi numerici per i PDE: metodi di elementi finiti, metodi immersi/inadatti, omogeneizzazione o analisi isogeometriche sono particolarmente rilevanti

• Sei abile in Python; l'esperienza precedente con la libreria FEniCS è un plus; la conoscenza C++ è un asset aggiuntivo

• Hai forti competenze computazionali, tra cui l'implementazione di pipeline di simulazione e ottimizzazione; l'esperienza con HPC o l'informatica scientifica su larga scala è un plus

• Hai un record di pubblicazione (relativo alla tua fase di carriera) in riviste leader a livello internazionale in meccanica computazionale, matematica applicata, o aree correlate

• Sei appassionato di matematica e informatica scientifica, e motivato da problemi impegnativi

• Siete indipendenti, creativi e orientati alla soluzione, con forti capacità di autogestione e la capacità di portare avanti la ricerca con una supervisione limitata

• Pensate criticamente e siete desiderosi di lavorare all'interfaccia di simulazione numerica e progettazione strutturale per architetture retice/metamateriali

• Si comunica eccellentemente in inglese scritto e orale

• Sei un giocatore di squadra, aperto alla collaborazione interdisciplinare

descriptionByLocale.en:
About us and our project

The Chair of Numerical Modelling and Simulation at EPFL is dedicated to the design and analysis of numerical algorithms for partial differential equations. Our research is oriented towards the development of novel and innovative numerical techniques aiming at improving the integration between numerical simulations and geometric modelling and processing.

Within the project «FLASh: Fast simulation tools for LAttice Structures» , funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation, we are opening a postdoctoral position for developing efficient algorithms for the topology optimization of architected materials using finite element technique

What you will do

As a postdoc in our group, you will lead research on the design and implementation of mathematically sound methods for the topology optimization of architected materials, leveraging fast simulation techniques such as unfitted finite element methods, domain decomposition, reduced order modeling, or isogeometric analysis. You will work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, contributing to both the theoretical development and the software implementation of these methods. More specifically:

• Lead and contribute to research projects in the broad areas of numerical simulation and topology optimization, within FLASh and related initiatives

• Develop, implement, and maintain in-house simulation and topology optimization software

• Analyze, interpret, and publish results in leading international journals

• Present your work at national and international conferences and build a strong network in the field

• Mentor and co-supervise PhD and Master students

• Contribute to teaching activities within the group

• Assist in the preparation of grant proposals and project reports

•

You are the ideal candidate if

• You hold a PhD (or are nearing completion of one) in mathematics, computational mechanics, engineering, or a related field

• You have a strong background in topology optimization, ideally with experience in density-based methods (SIMP), level set approaches, or related design-for-manufacturing frameworks

• You have research experience in numerical methods for PDEs: finite element methods, immersed/unfitted methods, homogenization, or isogeometric analysis are particularly relevant

• You are proficient in Python; prior experience with the FEniCS library is a plus; C++ knowledge is an additional asset

• You have strong computational skills, including the implementation of simulation and optimization pipelines; experience with HPC or large-scale scientific computing is a plus

• You have a publication record (relative to your career stage) in internationally leading journals in computational mechanics, applied mathematics, or related areas

• You are passionate about mathematics and scientific computing, and motivated by challenging problems

• You are independent, creative, and solution-oriented, with strong self-management skills and the ability to drive research forward with limited supervision

• You think critically and are eager to work at the interface of numerical simulation and structural design for lattice/metamaterial architectures

• You communicate excellently in written and oral English

• You are a team player, open to interdisciplinary collaboration

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment located in beautiful Switzerland

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions. More information can be found on our website

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

• Friendly and supportive team culture

• A 1+1 years contract

If you are interested

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

• A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

• A C

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

En tant qu’Adjoint.e EM-PP / Responsable de l’assurance qualité, vous pilotez le système qualité de l’EPFL et assurez la préparation ainsi que le suivi de l’accréditation institutionnelle. À ce titre, vous conseillez la Direction dans la définition, la mise en œuvre et le suivi de sa politique d’assurance qualité. Vous soutenez les équipes de la Présidence pour le contrôle qualité et la rédaction de divers documents stratégiques et thématiques. Par votre approche transversale et votre capacité d’influence, vous assurez un lien étroit entre stratégie, exigences d’accréditation et mise en œuvre opérationnelle, contribuant ainsi à renforcer la culture qualité de l’institution.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Assurer le pilotage du système d’assurance qualité de l’EPFL et coordonner les démarches liées à l’accréditation institutionnelle

• Mener la Commission Qualité pour le compte de la Direction et coordonner ses travaux, ainsi que les plans d’actions qualité et leur déploiement en collaboration et en soutien aux différentes instances de gouvernance et la communauté EPFL

• Promouvoir une culture qualité au sein de l’institution, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes, et entretenir des liens avec les homologues d’autres institutions académiques en Suisse et à l’international

• Collaboration étroite avec le service de la gestion des risques et compliance

• Rédiger et assurer le contrôle qualité de documents de la Direction, en particulier en lien avec les dossiers de la Vice-présidence en charge de l’éducation et de la recherche ainsi que les dossiers de la Présidence

• Contribuer à la rédaction de textes réglementaires, en lien avec les dossiers de la Direction et veiller à leur bonne application en collaboration avec les Affaires juridiques

• Mener, coordonner ou contribuer à des projets de gouvernance en lien avec l’état-major de la Présidence

Profil

• MSc ou PhD

• Gestion de projets avec orientation amélioration continue

• Bonne connaissance des standards d’accréditation suisses

• 5 ans minimum d’expérience professionnelle dans l’évaluation ou la révision des curricula bachelor / master ou fonction d’auditeur interne dans une université ou participation aux travaux d’une agence d’évaluation ou d’accréditation de l’enseignement supérieur ou expérience équivalente en gestion de la qualité, audit ou amélioration continue dans un environnement académique ou complexe.

• Vorbereitung und Gewährleistung der Qualitätskontrolle der Dokumente der Direktion, insbesondere in Bezug auf die Akten des für Bildung und Forschung zuständigen Vizepräsidenten und die Akten des Vorsitzes

• Beitrag zur Ausarbeitung von Verordnungen im Zusammenhang mit den Akten der Direktion und Gewährleistung ihrer wirksamen Umsetzung in Zusammenarbeit mit Recht

• Leitung, Koordinierung oder Beitrag zu Governance-Projekten im Zusammenhang mit dem Präsidiumspersonal

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione Guidato dal Prof. Suliana Manley di EPFL, il Laboratorio di Biofisica Sperimentale (LEB) è leader mondiale nella ricerca di microscopia e biofisica cellulare. La missione del LEB è quella di formare la prossima generazione di biofisici, e di eseguire ricerche all'avanguardia. Sviluppiamo microscopi che permettono un'imaging cellulare vivo più delicato, e li usiamo per studiare mitocondri – un organello chiave nel metabolismo, la salute e la malattia. Stiamo lanciando un progetto di 6 anni finanziato dall'Europa (ERC Synergy), con partner di collaborazione all'Università di Berna e al MPI Heidelberg per studiare le interazioni tra mitocondri e organelli partner. Il team LEB è composto da circa 10 dottorandi e compagni postdottoriali, e due tecnici. Eseguiamo la ricerca e l'insegnamento, e viaggiamo a conferenze per interagire con la comunità della ricerca. All'interno della nostra collaborazione ERC, prevediamo l'organizzazione di visite scientifiche, eventi di team building e incontri congiunti e seminari. Riconosciamo il supporto amministrativo e di comunicazione come elementi essenziali per il nostro successo come team. Siamo lieti di accogliere un nuovo specialista amministrativo che supporterà le nostre operazioni interne e il nostro progetto collaborativo. Missione Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista altamente motivato e organizzato per sostenere la ricerca di impatto, guidato dalla missione all'interno di un ambiente collaborativo e ad alte prestazioni. Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno che prospera sulla soluzione di problemi, processi di razionalizzazione, e garantire una comunicazione chiara tra le squadre. Faresti parte della squadra e riferisci al Prof. Suliana Manley. Principali doveri e responsabilità Finanza e contabilità
• Gestire le carte di credito, gli acquisti e il follow-up degli ordini, comprese le questioni fiscali
• Superare i bilanci (forecasting, monitoraggio delle spese e allocazione tra le fonti di finanziamento)
• Preparare relazioni finanziarie accurate e tempestive
• Assicurare un follow-through di attività coerente e elevati standard di accuratezza, in particolare nelle comunicazioni esterne
• Identificare e implementare miglioramenti per ottimizzare i processi finanziari e la comunicazione Viaggi e conferenze
• pianificare e coordinare eventi e visite (10–50 partecipanti, tra cui membri del laboratorio, ospiti accademici, relatori invitati e candidati)

Description Led by EPFL’s Prof. Suliana Manley, the Laboratory of Experimental Biophysics (LEB) is a world leader in microscopy and cellular biophysics research. The mission of the LEB is to train the next generation of biophysicists, and to perform cutting-edge research. We develop microscopes that enable gentler live cell imaging, and use them to study mitochondria – a key organelle in metabolism, health, and disease. We are launching a 6-year European-funded (ERC Synergy) project, with collaborating partners at the University of Bern and the MPI Heidelberg to study the interactions between mitochondria and partner organelles. The LEB team consists of around 10 PhD students and postdoctoral fellows, and two technical staff. We carry out research and teaching, and travel to conferences to engage with the research community. Within our ERC collaboration, we anticipate organizing scientific visits, team-building events, and joint meetings and seminars. We recognize administrative and communication support as essential elements for our success as a team. We look forward to welcoming a new administrative specialist who will support our internal operations as well as our collaborative project. Warenbezeichnung Das Labor für Experimentelle Biophysik (LEB) ist weltweit führend in der Mikroskopie- und Zellbiophysik-Forschung. Die Mission der LEB ist es, die nächste Generation von Biophysikern zu trainieren und innovative Forschung durchzuführen. Wir entwickeln Mikroskope, die eine sanftere Live-Zell-Bildgebung ermöglichen, und verwenden sie, um mitochondrien zu studieren – eine Schlüsselorganelle in Stoffwechsel, Gesundheit und Krankheit. Wir starten ein 6-jähriges European-funded (ERC Synergy) Projekt, mit Kooperationspartnern an der Universität Bern und dem MPI Heidelberg, um die Interaktionen zwischen Mitochondrien und Partnerorganellen zu studieren. Das LEB-Team besteht aus rund 10 Doktoranden und Postdoktoranden und zwei technischen Mitarbeitern. Wir führen Forschung und Lehre durch und reisen zu Konferenzen, um sich mit der Forschungsgemeinschaft zu beschäftigen. In unserer ERC-Zusammenarbeit rechnen wir mit der Organisation von wissenschaftlichen Besuchen, Teambuilding-Events und gemeinsamen Treffen und Seminaren. Wir erkennen administrative und Kommunikationsunterstützung als wesentliche Elemente für unseren Erfolg als Team. Wir freuen uns auf die Begrüßung eines neuen Verwaltungsspezialisten, der unsere internen Operationen sowie unser gemeinsames Projekt unterstützen wird. Missione

La vostra missione è di sostenere le attività dell'Ufficio Sostenibilità SV, che sta lavorando sull'implementazione del Green Labs Vision EPFL

Designazione

L'Ufficio Sostenibilità della Facoltà di Scienze della Vita (SV) è responsabile della sostenibilità ambientale all'interno della facoltà di EPFL. Lavoriamo all'interno del decanato e siamo in contatto con la comunità scientifica, amministrativa e studentesca della facoltà SV per integrare la visione "Green Lab". Questa visione è quella di condurre una ricerca ambientale e socialmente responsabile senza compromettere la qualità della ricerca. La nostra stretta collaborazione con EPFL Sustainability ci permette di costruire progetti di sostenibilità tenendo conto delle specificità del settore delle scienze biologiche. In questo contesto, stiamo cercando un addestratore motivato per contribuire ai numerosi progetti e eventi Green Labs SV.

Principali compiti e responsabilità

• contribuire alla realizzazione e alla finalizzazione dell'e-learning sulla buona pratica in
durata del laboratorio.

• Supporta le attività di reporting e crea i media di comunicazione evidenziando
best practice nella sostenibilità della facoltà (ad esempio guide, brochure, infografie,
sito web).

• Analizzare i dati e valutare gli impatti ambientali dei laboratori e
Piattaforme tecnologiche della Facoltà SV.

• Valutare i principali acquisti SV (costo, peso e impronta di carbonio).

• Mapping e analisi dei flussi di plastica all'interno della facoltà e leve di identificazione
Le chiavi per ridurre l'uso di plastica.

• Organizzare eventi per sensibilizzare e informare la comunità sulla sostenibilità
(Fresque of plastic, Days of Sustainability, Green Academy).

Profilo

• Master in ingegneria ambientale, scienze naturali, sostenibilità o campo simile
(lo stage deve iniziare entro 12 mesi dalla laurea).

• Forte interesse per le questioni di sostenibilità, soprattutto nella ricerca accademica.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in francese e inglese, sia per iscritto che per via orale.

• Esperienza nell'analisi dei dati.

• Capacità di collaborare efficacemente con vari stakeholder.

• Creatività, autonomia, rigore organizzativo e iniziativa.

• Spirito collaborativo e adattabilità

Offriamo

• L'opportunità di contribuire a stimolare progetti per ridurre gli impatti ambientali
nella ricerca accademica

• Un quadro flessibile in un team dinamico e multidisciplinare

Informazioni

Data effettiva: Dal luglio 2026

Tasso di occupazione minimo: 100%

Tasso massimo di occupazione: 100%

Tipo di contratto: CSD

Durata: 6 mesi

Mission

Your mission is to support the activities of the SV Sustainability Office, which is working on the implementation of the Green Labs Vision EPFL

Description

The Sustainability Office of the Faculty of Life Sciences (SV) is responsible for environmental sustainability within the faculty at EPFL. We work within the decanate and are in touch with the scientific, administrative and student community of the SV faculty to integrate the "Green Lab" vision. This vision is to conduct environmentally and socially responsible research without compromising the quality of the research. Our close collaboration with EPFL Sustainability enables us to build sustainability projects taking into account the specificities of the life sciences field. In this context, we are looking for a motivated trainee to contribute to the many Green Labs SV projects and events.

Main tasks and responsibilities

• To contribute to the realization and finalization of e-learning on good practice in
laboratory durability.

• Support reporting activities and create communication media highlighting
best practices in faculty sustainability (e.g. guides, brochures, infographics,
website).

• Analyze data and assess environmental impacts of laboratories and
Technology platforms of the SV Faculty.

• Evaluate the main SV purchases (cost, weight and carbon footprint).

• Mapping and analysing plastic flows within the faculty and identifying levers
Keys to reduce plastic use.

• Organize events to raise awareness and inform the community about sustainability
(Fresque of plastic, Days of Sustainability, Green Academy).

Profile

• Master in environmental engineering, natural sciences, sustainability or similar field
(the internship must begin within 12 months of graduation).

• Strong interest in sustainability issues, especially in academic research.

• Excellent communication skills in French and English, both in writing and oral.

• Experience in data analysis.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders.

• Creativity, autonomy, organizational rigour and initiative.

• Collaborative spirit and adaptability

We offer

• The opportunity to contribute to stimulating projects to reduce environmental impacts
in academic research

• A flexible framework within a dynamic and multidisciplinary team

Information

Effective date: From July 2026

Min occupancy rate: 100%

Max occupancy rate: 100%

Type of contract: CSD

Duration: 6 months

Reference: Mai-Phuong Dinh, SV Sustainability Project Manager, May-phuong.dinh@epfl.ch, +41 21 693 08 68

Mission

Votre mission est d’apporter votre support dans les activités du bureau de durabilité SV qui oeuvre à l’implémentation de la vision Green Labs EPFL

Description

Le bureau de durabilité de la faculté Sciences de la vie (SV) est responsable de la durabilité environnementale au sein de la faculté à l’EPFL. Nous travaillons au sein du décanat et sommes en lien avec la communauté scientifique, administrative et estudiantine de la faculté SV afin d’intégrer la vision « Green Lab ». Notre étroite collaboration avec Durabilité EPFL nous permet de construire des projets de durabilité en tenant compte des spécificités du domaine des Sciences de la Vie. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un·e stagiaire motivé·e de contribuer aux nombreux projets et événements Green Labs SV.

les meilleures pratiques de durabilité de la faculté (par ex. : guides, brochures, infographies,

au sein de la recherche académique

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione Stiamo cercando un ricercatore postdoctoral altamente motivato per sviluppare le strutture di decodifica neurale di prossima generazione per i dati multimodali del motore e neurali in pazienti con disturbi del movimento. Il progetto si concentra sulla leva di approcci di apprendimento automatico all'avanguardia per prevedere e quantificare i cambiamenti nella funzione motoria e cognitiva, integrando l'elettrofisiologia (ad esempio, LFP, EEG) con il rilevamento indossabile per il monitoraggio in tempo reale e senza ostacoli. Il candidato di successo contribuirà sia all'innovazione metodologica che alla traduzione clinica, lavorando a stretto contatto con pazienti, medici e un team di ricerca multidisciplinare. Chi siamo Il laboratorio SPARK per la neuromodulazione adattiva presso École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) e presso l'Ospedale Universitario di Losanna (CHUV) sta sviluppando terapie di neuromodulazione a ciclo chiuso di prossima generazione per ripristinare la mobilità in pazienti con malattia di Parkinson e disturbi correlati. La nostra ricerca combina ingegneria, neuroscienze e traduzione clinica per affrontare tre obiettivi fondamentali: (i) per caratterizzare esaurientemente i deficit di mobilità nel tempo, le fasi della malattia e i fenotipi del paziente; (ii) per scoprire i meccanismi neurali sottostanti all'andatura e agli squilibri di equilibrio; e (iii) per progettare algoritmi predittivi che attivano e regolano in tempo reale la stimolazione. Embedded all'interno del Neuro-X Institute di EPFL e del NeuroRestore Center di CHUV-UNIL-EPFL, il laboratorio beneficia di un ecosistema di traduzione unico che spazia dalla neurochirurgia (Prof. J. Bloch, Prof. J. Squair), neurologia (Dr. J. Bally), neuroscienze (Prof. G. Courtine, Prof. M. Anderson), e neuroengine Loering (Prof.). Questo ambiente favorisce strette partnership con aziende MedTech come Medtronic e ONWARD Medical per accelerare la traduzione clinica. Negli ultimi dieci anni, il nostro team ha stabilito una piattaforma sperimentale unica che combina la cinematica integrale ad alta risoluzione, le registrazioni delle attività muscolari e i segnali neurali su larga scala (registrazioni subcorticali e corticali). Questo approccio integrato consente lo sviluppo di terapie personalizzate e indipendenti dalle attività attraverso le condizioni neurologiche, tra cui la malattia di Parkinson, lesione del midollo spinale e ictus. EPFL fornisce un ambiente di livello mondiale in ingegneria, calcolo e neuroscienze, consentendo lo sviluppo di algoritmi avanzati e sistemi in tempo reale per la distribuzione del mondo reale. Queste capacità sono strettamente integrate con l’infrastruttura clinica di CHUV, uno dei cinque ospedali universitari della Svizzera e l’unico centro della regione francofona che effettua una stimolazione cerebrale profonda per i disturbi del movimento. La posizione sarà basata presso il Campus Biotech di Ginevra e coinvolgerà interazioni regolari con i team EPFL e CHUV di Losanna. Principali doveri e responsabilità
• Sviluppare e implementare quadri di decodifica neurale all'avanguardia per set di dati multimodali e neurali
• Identificare e convalidare i biomarcatori neurali clinicamente rilevanti in condizioni terapeutiche.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo di strategie di neuromodulazione a ciclo chiuso e adattiva, e all'implementazione di piattaforme neuromonitoring di prossima generazione che integrano la cinematica ad alta risoluzione, la modellazione neurobiomeccanica e la decodifica neurale per la consegna di terapia a ciclo chiuso.
• Integrare la decodifica neurale con sistemi di rilevamento indossabili per il monitoraggio in tempo reale e non limitato
• Progettare e condurre esperimenti in stretta collaborazione con medici e pazienti.
• Superare gli studenti MSc/PhD e contribuire al coordinamento dei progetti in corso all'interno del team.
• Contribuire a pubblicazioni ad alto impatto e concedere la scrittura, la diffusione scientifica e lo sviluppo di collaborazioni tra EPFL, CHUV e istituzioni partner.
• Aiutare a coordinare le attività di laboratorio e sostenere la strutturazione di un ambiente di ricerca collaborativo e ad alto rendimento. Profilo
• Hai un dottorato in neurotecnologia, ingegneria neurale, neuroscienze computazionali, cervello-com
descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to develop next-generation neural decoding frameworks for multimodal motor and neural data in patients with movement disorders. The project focuses on leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning approaches to predict and quantify changes in motor and cognitive function, while integrating electrophysiology (e.g., LFP, EEG) with wearable sensing for real-world, unconstrained monitoring. The successful candidate will contribute to both methodological innovation and clinical translation, working closely with patients, clinicians, and a multidisciplinary research team. Who we are The SPARK laboratory for Adaptive Neuromodulation at École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) and at the University Hospital Lausanne (CHUV) is developing next-generation closed loop neuromodulation therapies to restore mobility in patients with Parkinson’s disease and related disorders. Our research combines engineering, neuroscience, and clinical translation to address three core objectives: (i) to comprehensively characterize mobility deficits across time, disease stages, and patient phenotypes; (ii) to uncover the neural mechanisms underlying gait and balance impairments; and (iii) to design predictive algorithms that adaptively trigger and regulate stimulation in real time. Embedded within the Neuro-X Institute at EPFL and the NeuroRestore Center at CHUV–UNIL-EPFL, the lab benefits from a uniquely translational ecosystem spanning neurosurgery (Prof. J. Bloch, Prof. J. Squair), neurology (Dr. J. Bally), neuroscience (Prof. G. Courtine, Prof. M. Anderson), and neuroengineering (Prof. H. Lorach). This environment fosters close partnerships with MedTech companies such as Medtronic and ONWARD Medical to accelerate clinical translation. Over the past decade, our team has established a unique experimental platform combining high-resolution whole-body kinematics, muscle activity recordings, and large-scale neural signals (subcortical and cortical recordings). This integrated approach enables the development of personalized, activity-dependent therapies across neurological conditions, including Parkinson’s disease, spinal cord injury, and stroke. EPFL provides a world-class environment in engineering, computation and neuroscience, enabling the develop-ment of advanced algorithms and real-time systems for real-world deployment. These capabilities are tightly integrated with CHUV’s clinical infrastructure, one of Switzerland’s five university hospitals and the only center in the French-speaking region performing deep brain stimulation for movement disorders. The position will be based at Campus Biotech in Geneva and will involve regular interactions with EPFL and CHUV teams in Lausanne. Main duties and responsibilities
• Develop and implement state-of-the-art neural decoding frameworks for multimodal motor and neural datasets
• Identify and validate clinically relevant neural biomarkers across therapeutic conditions.
• Contribute to the development of closed-loop and adaptive neuromodulation strategies, and to the deployment of next-generation neuromonitoring platforms integrating high-resolution kinematics, neurobiomechanical modeling, and neural decoding for closed-loop therapy delivery.
• Integrate neural decoding with wearable sensing systems for real-world, unconstrained monitoring
• Design and conduct experiments in close collaboration with clinicians and patients.
• Supervise MSc/PhD students and contribute to the coordination of ongoing projects within the team.
• Contribute to high-impact publications and to grant writing, scientific dissemination, and the development of collaborations across EPFL, CHUV, and partner institutions.
• Help coordinate laboratory activities and support the structuring of a collaborative and high-performing research environment. Profile
• You hold a PhD in neurotechnology, neural engineering, computational neuroscience, brain–com

Squair), Neurologie (Dr. J. Bally), Neurowissenschaften (Prof. G. Courtine, Prof. M. Anderson) und Neuroengineering (Prof. H. Diese Umgebung fördert enge Partnerschaften mit MedTech-Unternehmen wie Medtronic und ONWARD Medical, um die klinische Übersetzung zu beschleunigen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission Nous recherchons un chercheur postdoctoral hautement motivé pour élaborer des cadres de décodage neuronal de nouvelle génération pour les données mobiles et neurales multimodales chez les patients atteints de troubles du mouvement. Le projet vise à tirer parti d'approches d'apprentissage automatique de pointe pour prédire et quantifier les changements dans les fonctions motrices et cognitives, tout en intégrant l'électrophysiologie (p. ex. LFP, EEG) à la détection portable pour la surveillance réelle et sans contrainte. Le candidat retenu contribuera à l'innovation méthodologique et à la traduction clinique, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les patients, les cliniciens et une équipe de recherche multidisciplinaire. Qui nous sommes Le laboratoire SPARK pour la neuromodulation adaptative de l'École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) et de l'Hôpital Universitaire Lausanne (CHUV) développe des thérapies de neuromodulation en boucle fermée de nouvelle génération pour rétablir la mobilité des patients atteints de la maladie de Parkinson et de troubles connexes. Notre recherche combine l'ingénierie, les neurosciences et la traduction clinique pour répondre à trois objectifs principaux : (i) caractériser de façon exhaustive les déficits de mobilité à travers le temps, les stades de la maladie et les phénotypes des patients; (ii) découvrir les mécanismes neuraux sous-jacents à la démarche et équilibrer les déficiences; (iii) concevoir des algorithmes prédictifs qui déclenchent et régulent adaptativement la stimulation en temps réel. Intégré à l'Institut Neuro-X de l'EPFL et au Centre NeuroRestore de CHUV–UNIL-EPFL, le laboratoire bénéficie d'un écosystème translationnel unique couvrant la neurochirurgie (Prof. J. Bloch, Prof. J. Squair), la neurologie (Dr. J. Bally), la neuroscience (Prof. G. Courtine, Prof. M. Anderson) et la neuroingénierie (Prof. H. Lorach). Cet environnement favorise des partenariats étroits avec des entreprises MedTech telles que Medtronic et ONWARD Medical pour accélérer la traduction clinique. Au cours de la dernière décennie, notre équipe a établi une plateforme expérimentale unique combinant la cinématique du corps entier à haute résolution, les enregistrements de l'activité musculaire et les signaux neuraux à grande échelle (enregistrements subcorticaux et corticaux). Cette approche intégrée permet le développement de thérapies personnalisées dépendantes de l'activité dans toutes les affections neurologiques, y compris la maladie de Parkinson, les lésions de la moelle épinière et les accidents vasculaires cérébraux. L'EPFL offre un environnement de classe mondiale en ingénierie, calcul et neuroscience, permettant le développement d'algorithmes avancés et de systèmes en temps réel pour le déploiement du monde réel. Ces capacités sont étroitement intégrées avec l'infrastructure clinique du CHUV, l'un des cinq hôpitaux universitaires de Suisse et le seul centre de la région francophone qui effectue une stimulation cérébrale profonde pour les troubles du mouvement. Le poste sera basé au Campus Biotech à Genève et comportera des interactions régulières avec les équipes de l'EPFL et du CHUV à Lausanne. Principales fonctions et responsabilités
• Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des cadres de décodage neuronal à la fine pointe de la technologie pour les ensembles de données multimodaux sur les moteurs et les neurones
• Identifier et valider les biomarqueurs neuronaux cliniquement pertinents dans toutes les conditions thérapeutiques.
• Contribuer au développement de stratégies de neuromodulation en boucle fermée et adaptative, ainsi qu'au déploiement de plates-formes de neurosurveillance de prochaine génération intégrant la cinématique à haute résolution, la modélisation neurobiomécanique et le décodage neuronal pour l'accouchement en boucle fermée.
• Intégrer le décodage neuronal avec des systèmes de détection portables pour une surveillance réelle et sans contrainte
• Concevoir et mener des expériences en étroite collaboration avec les cliniciens et les patients.
• Superviser les étudiants en MSc/PhD et contribuer à la coordination des projets en cours au sein de l'équipe.
• Contribuer à l'élaboration de publications à fort impact et à l'octroi de publications, à la diffusion scientifique et au développement de collaborations entre l'EPFL, le CHUV et les institutions partenaires.
• Aider à coordonner les activités de laboratoire et soutenir la structuration d'un environnement de recherche collaboratif et performant. Profil
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en neurotechnologie, génie neurologique, neurosciences informatiques, cerveau–com
